name: BACH_0053_FSIM_blur3
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Benign (73%)** · Unreliable input · Careful review
Severe blur flags input reliability [F6], and the 90% conformal set cannot separate Benign from InSitu (22%) [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Top probabilities | Benign 73%, InSitu 22%, Normal 3%, Invasive 2% | Favors Benign; InSitu remains possible |
| Conformal set | Benign, InSitu (alpha 10%; test coverage 90%, n=132) | Cannot rule out InSitu |
| Reliability / OOD | 30% reliability (flagged), 100th percentile OOD, blur 3 | Suspect input; out of distribution |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Disagree on top class | Independent foundation models disagree |
| Similar cases | 2/5 Benign, 3/5 Normal (40% agreement) [F5] | Split between Benign and Normal |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 1) · ↓ invasive · Below-typical score (-0.424) pushes away from invasive carcinoma [F2] · Validated
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (region 7) · ↑ invasive · Low score (-0.009) pushes toward invasive; unreliable 0/20 check [F3] · Unreliable
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (regions 0, 10) · context · Above-typical score (1.063); descriptive context only [F4] · Weak
- **Gland / tubule formation** (regions 3, 6, 7) · ↓ invasive · High score (1.13) pushes away from invasive carcinoma · Weak

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful to classifier; removing top 3 risk regions drops P(invasive) by 0.0114 vs random (95% CI 0.0021 to 0.0197).
- **Concepts**: Unproven faithfulness (deletion diff 0.0008, 95% CI -0.0088 to 0.0064 includes 0); normal lobules (0/20 spot check) is unreliable.

## Could be wrong if
- Severe blur (severity 3, 100th percentile OOD) masks in situ or invasive features; a recut H&E is drafted.
- Unsampled ductal atypia represents InSitu (22%); deeper levels are drafted and frozen margin assessment is deferred [F7].

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 2, 1**: Highest risk (10%, 6%) and superior margin (81% score); inspect for invasion or atypia.
2. **Regions 5, 8**: Check duct-confined atypia (region 5) and pleomorphism (region 8, contrasting Normal case BACH_0195).
3. **Regions 0, 10**: Dense lymphocytic infiltrate and inferior margin (58% score in region 10); verify tissue quality.
